description: Active filter, field bus gateway of the control computer: system state, commands, error code, grid, load and filter measurements and harmonics
source: Maschinenfabrik Reinhausen, field bus configuration manual of the Anybus module, PQ-01-12-05-BA, appendices I and II

sources.title: GRIDCON ACF / PCS, Feldbus Konfiguration (Anybus-Modul), PQ-01-12-05-BA
sources.note: chapters 2 and 3, appendices I and II; copy published in the OpenEMS repository

notes: This is the standard filter data set (anlagenkonfiguration.customization=0 in CONFIGS/SETTINGS.TXT, with general.anybusenabled=1). Customised data sets use other registers and are not covered.
The manual does not state the word order of 32-bit values: low word first is assumed, as in a published third-party driver for another data set of the same gateway. Check it on the first read.
Holding registers are numbered from 0. The manual notes that some tools count from 1: then add 1 to every address.

Commands: the control computer acts on a change of value. Keep the command for about 500 ms and then write 0. Write the three command registers in one request. Do not change the parameter set more than once a second.
Operator mode Service (the default) takes commands from the touch panel only, apart from STOP.

With connection monitoring on (the default), a missing Modbus request within the process timeout puts the unit in the error 'Connection Terminated'; the manual gives 10000 ms as the default. Check modbus.tcp.processtimeout or modbus.rtu.processtimeout.
Defaults: IP 10.0.0.2, mask 255.255.0.0; RTU node 10, 19200 baud, even parity.
Harmonics are four blocks of 16 values per phase; the last block holds orders 49 to 51. Voltage harmonics are phase to neutral, relative to the fundamental.
The setpoint blocks (688, 720) are unused and are not mapped.
